# src

Core implementation of git-lanes, a git worktree session manager enabling parallel development workflows through isolated branches, manifest-based change tracking, and conflict detection across concurrent worktrees.

## Contents

**Entry Point**
- [cli.ts](./cli.ts) — Command-line parser with `parseArgs()`, `main()` dispatcher routing to session lifecycle (`startSession`, `endSession`, `abortSession`), change tracking (`trackFiles`, `sessionCommit`, `undoLastCommit`), and integration commands (`squashSession`, `mergeSession`, `pushSession`).

**Core Session Management**
- [session.ts](./session.ts) — Session lifecycle via `resolveSession()`, `startSession()`, `endSession()`, `abortSession()`; commit operations `sessionCommit()`, `undoLastCommit()`, `squashSession()`; queries `getSessionStatus()`, `getSessionLog()`, `listSessions()`.
- [manifest.ts](./manifest.ts) — `SessionManifest` persistence with `createManifest()`, `saveManifest()`, `loadManifest()`; changeset management via `addChangeset()`, `removeLastChangeset()`; atomic writes using `withLock()` from `./utils/lock.ts`.

**Git Operations**
- [git.ts](./git.ts) — Synchronous git wrapper with `git()`, `gitSafe()` execution; branch/worktree ops (`createBranch`, `addWorktree`, `listWorktrees`); staging/commit (`add`, `commit`, `resetSoft`, `resetMixed`); history (`log`, `logBetween`, `commitCount`).

**Conflict Detection**
- [conflicts.ts](./conflicts.ts) — `checkConflicts()` detects overlapping files via `loadAllManifests()`; `formatConflictReport()` formats output; `suggestResolutions()` generates actionable strings; `checkAutoMergePossibility()` uses `git merge-tree` with `<<<<<<<` marker detection.

**Configuration**
- [config.ts](./config.ts) — `loadConfig()` reads `.lanes.json`; types `MainBranchPolicy`, `ForceCleanup`, `AdoptChanges`; `DEFAULT_CONFIG` with `branch_prefix: "lanes/"`, `main_branch_policy: "block"`.

**Test Execution**
- [test-runner.ts](./test-runner.ts) — `detectTestCommand()` checks bunfig.toml, package.json, Cargo.toml, etc.; `runSessionTests()` executes in session worktree; `runCombinedTests()` creates temp worktree at `.lanes/tmp-combined-test` for merged testing.

## Subdirectories

- [forge/](./forge/) — Pull request creation via `createPullRequest()` delegating to platform-specific CLI tools (gh, glab, bb) for github, gitlab, bitbucket.
- [hooks/](./hooks/) — AI assistant hook installation via `installHooks()`, `uninstallHooks()` for claude-code, cursor, aider adapters.
- [utils/](./utils/) — Infrastructure: `lock.ts` (`acquireLock`, `withLock`), `logger.ts` (`log.info`, `log.error`), `validation.ts` (`validateSessionName`, `validateCommitMessage`).

## Architecture

**Command Flow**: `cli.ts` `main()` → session.ts functions → manifest.ts persistence → git.ts execution.

**Session Resolution Priority** in `resolveSession()`: explicit `--session` flag > worktree path detection > single session fallback > PPID affinity (`clientId === String(process.ppid)`).

**Manifest Storage**: `<git-common-dir>/lanes-manifests/<name>.json` with `MANIFEST_VERSION = 1`, enabling cross-worktree session visibility.

**Worktree Layout**: `.lanes/worktrees/{name}` with symlinks to `config.shared_dirs` from `loadConfig()`.

## Behavioral Contracts

**CLI Flags**: `--session/-s` (session alias), `--forge/-f` (github|gitlab|bitbucket, default "github"), `--title/-t`, `--body/-b`, `--command/-c`, `--adapter/-a`.

**Session Name Validation**: `SESSION_NAME_REGEX=/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$/`, `MAX_SESSION_NAME_LENGTH`, `DANGEROUS_CHARS=/[;&|`$(){}[\]!#~'"\\<>]/` in `validateSessionName()`.

**Lock Expiration**: `LOCK_STALE_MS = 30_000` threshold in `isLockStale()`.

**Merge Conflict Detection**: `git merge-tree` stdout checked for verbatim `<<<<<<<` pattern in `checkAutoMergePossibility()`.

**Error Sentinels**: `"No active session found"` in `checkConflicts()`; `"Session '${name}' not found"` in manifest operations.

**Default Branch Fallback**: `getDefaultBranch()` checks `origin/HEAD` symbolic-ref, falls back to `main`/`master` existence, defaults `"main"`.

**Auto-Commit Message**: `"WIP: session {name} final commit"` generated in `endSession()` when `hasUncommittedChanges`.

**Changeset ID Format**: `cs-${Date.now()}` in `sessionCommit()`.

- `cli.ts` → `session.ts` (all session operations), `conflicts.ts` (`checkConflicts`, `formatConflictReport`), `test-runner.ts` (`runSessionTests`, `runCombinedTests`), `forge/github.ts` (`createPullRequest`), `hooks/install.ts` (`installHooks`), `config.ts` (`loadConfig`), `git.ts` (`isInsideGitRepo`).

## Workflow & Conventions

**Synchronous Execution**: All git operations in `git.ts` use `spawnSync` — no async/await patterns.

**Argument Arrays**: All `git()` calls use argument arrays to prevent shell injection.

**Porcelain Formats**: Git commands use `--porcelain`, `--format=%(refname:short)` for parseable output.

**Atomic Writes**: `saveManifest()` uses temp file (`<path>.tmp.<pid>`) + `renameSync` wrapped in `withLock()`.

**Error Handling**: `loadConfig()` and `loadManifest()` silently return defaults/null on errors; lifecycle functions throw on session not found.

**Worktree Cleanup**: `cleanupSession()` attempts non-force removal, falls back to force, then deletes manifest.
